name: rail-yard-equipment
about: A sound square ad: a white tractor at a fuel island at night. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-yard-equipment`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: a night scene, the truck legible, the kit's colours

subject_legible.reason: The white Freightliner semi-truck is clearly visible at a fuel stop, instantly recognizable as a tractor at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline calls for OTR drivers and the picture shows a long-haul tractor at a truck stop, telling a perfectly unified story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The bold white headline dominates the lower half, the outlined 'Apply Now' button sits cleanly below it, and the dark green overlay prevents the photo from competing with the text.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep dark-green (#0B3D2E) tints the photo overlay, fills the footer bar, and frames the button, with white used for all text, matching both brand colours perfectly; no logo is provided to check.
